archetypes.name: dyn-launch-contract
archetypes.rationale: The change adds an assessment-specific contract to a heavily shared Codex and Cursor launcher.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the assessment-only launcher flags and verify ordinary review behavior remains unchanged. Trace underlying exit metadata, required sidecars, Cursor result extraction, repository baselining, and Codex evidence grants across both success and failure paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
